sermon.title: Four Dilemmas and Four Solutions
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer walks through Isaiah 36–39 and four dilemmas Hezekiah faced: the Assyrian army, the word from God that he would die, a sickness, and the prophecy that his sons would be taken. He teaches that prayer, humility and repentance act as a “higher law” that can change even a God-given prophecy, and that Hezekiah’s failure to pray about the fourth dilemma left it to his son Manasseh. He closes with the power of the gospel and standing in the gap in prayer.

faqs.question: How long had Hezekiah reigned when Assyria attacked?
faqs.answer: He says Hezekiah “has reigned for 14 years, starting at age 25.”

faqs.question: What does he say prayer is?
faqs.answer: He says “prayed means to talk to God.”

faqs.question: Does he say confessing our sin is a “higher law”?
faqs.answer: Yes. He says “confessing, admitting your wrong is a higher law,” along with praise, humbling yourself and lifting your voice.

faqs.question: How fast does he say God relents when we turn?
faqs.answer: He says “the instant we turn” and jokes that it is “faster than popcorn.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: The instant I speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, to pull down, and to destroy it, if that nation against whom I have spoken turns from its evil, I will relent of the disaster that I thought to bring upon it.

faqs.question: Why does he say Jonah ran from God?
faqs.answer: He says “Jonah knew that God was merciful, God would change his mind if they repented.”

faqs.question: Does he say a real prophet can be wrong?
faqs.answer: No. He says “a prophet is never wrong.”

faqs.question: Does he say God defends the city because the people are worthy?
faqs.answer: No. He says “are we worthy? No,” and that God is going to do it “for his sake” and “for my servant David’s sake.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: “Therefore thus says the LORD concerning the king of Assyria: ‘He shall not come into this city, Nor shoot an arrow there, Nor come before it with shield, Nor build a siege mound against it. faqs.question: How many does he say the angel killed?
faqs.answer: He says “185,000” and “they just woke up dead. Because one man prayed.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then the angel of the LORD went out, and killed in the camp of the Assyrians one hundred and eighty-five thousand; and when people arose early in the morning, there were the corpses—all dead.

faqs.question: Does he say to confess specific sins out loud in front of people?
faqs.answer: No. He says “people don’t need to hear them, the specific… the gossip train will go.”

faqs.question: How many years did God add to Hezekiah’s life?
faqs.answer: He says “I will add to your days 15 years.”
